patch.value: Expose a contract-bound way to retrieve complete diagnostic legal domains from CLI refusals

PR #1696 review exposed an existing diagnostic limitation: --output-budget unbounded controls normal reads but does not override the fixed JSON diagnostic ceiling; large custom-schema legal domains can be compacted. The SDK error context retains the complete domain. Design an explicit declared diagnostic ceiling or separate domain discovery primitive without weakening default ceilings, dropping actionable recovery, or promising an ineffective retry.

Demonstrate a custom schema whose legal domain exceeds the default diagnostic ceiling; provide a CLI-only complete discovery or explicitly bounded restore path; preserve default diagnostic budgets and truthful omission receipts; prove CLI SDK MCP parity where applicable
Agents can retrieve a complete large legal domain through a declared CLI contract while normal refusals remain bounded.
